_comment: Where large media (audio, video, built players) live; they are never in Git. Root: $ARABIC_STORY_MEDIA, else the one-line file .media-root at the repository root (not tracked), else defaultRoot. defaultRoot "." = LOCAL mode: the repository's own folders, paths used as they are (narration in Animations/<story>/, finished films in MP4s/). Any other root = SHARED mode: 'map' turns a repository path into a path in that folder (longest prefix wins). sharedRootExample is the layout prepared on 2026-11-16 for a second macOS account. See DEVELOPMENT_SETUP.md.
